This report records source contracts and explicit differences. It does not equate old parametrized case totals, claim every referenced test is selected in both main lanes, or transfer canonical/private runtime results.

method: Fetched and matched every named canonical file against the nontruncated canonical Git tree.
Read the removed tests' contracts/assertions and relevant current-owner regressions, checked every cited current test definition exists in the exact current Git blob.
Bounded disposition is per file and contract; an old Python API/internal field/fixture can remain intentionally absent while a current workflow has its own tests.
Current test paths are references for source review. Actual source, installed and native populations remain governed by committed main/focused oracles and their receipts.

related_open_workflows.scope: Outside these 32 paths and outside the 19-file product ledger; standalone ASR is not an equivalent assistant durable-intent/partial-output workflow.

declared_non_equivalences: Canonical warm Dordiai process retention/drain/drop is not current per-utterance ownership; warm throughput is NOT_QUALIFIED.
Canonical raw SpeechSettings/sample-width/output-budget return APIs and token-hash voice IDs are not current aliases; historical metadata remains passive.
Current local helper and Dordiai fixtures prove bounded protocol behavior only, not private vendor inference, pronunciation or acoustic quality.
Current new ASR job execution is32GiB aggregate; canonical historical sources32GiB each and64GiB aggregate are preserved passively. No 64 GiB throughput was measured.
Old selected executable symlink/base-runtime discovery policy is not inherited by current complete regular-file manifest admission.
Old packaging download/helper/manifest APIs are replaced by the current selected pinned-archive setup and sealed bundle contracts, not silently imported.
Worker-bytecode source and installed-inventory coverage does not mean the two removed old-package sentinel tests were executed unchanged.
Registered progress native16 exercises actual settings and passive recovery with audio Off, not acoustic output.
